proof_body:
by
  intro p q hp hq hqp
  have hd : 0 ≤ p ^ 2 - q := by linarith
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt (p ^ 2 - q) ^ 2 = p ^ 2 - q := Real.sq_sqrt hd
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (p ^ 2 - q) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hsp : Real.sqrt (p ^ 2 - q) ≤ p := Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr ⟨hp, by linarith⟩
  generalize Real.sqrt (p ^ 2 - q) = s at hs2 hs0 hsp ⊢
  have hx : 0 ≤ (p + s) / 2 := by linarith
  have hy : 0 ≤ (p - s) / 2 := by linarith
  have hu2 := Real.sq_sqrt hx
  have hv2 := Real.sq_sqrt hy
  have hu0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg ((p + s) / 2)
  have hv0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg ((p - s) / 2)
  have hle : Real.sqrt ((p - s) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((p + s) / 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  generalize Real.sqrt ((p + s) / 2) = u at hu2 hu0 hle ⊢
  generalize Real.sqrt ((p - s) / 2) = v at hv2 hv0 hle ⊢
  have huv : 0 ≤ 2 * u * v := by
    have := mul_nonneg hu0 hv0
    linarith
  have hqeq : q = (2 * u * v) ^ 2 := by
    have h4 : (2 * u * v) ^ 2 = 4 * u ^ 2 * v ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [h4, hu2, hv2]
    linear_combination hs2
  have hrq : Real.sqrt q = 2 * u * v := by
    rw [hqeq]
    exact Real.sqrt_sq huv
  have hplus : p + 2 * u * v = (u + v) ^ 2 := by
    linear_combination -hu2 - hv2
  have hminus : p - 2 * u * v = (u - v) ^ 2 := by
    linear_combination -hu2 - hv2
  rw [hrq, hplus, hminus]
  exact ⟨Real.sqrt_sq (add_nonneg hu0 hv0), Real.sqrt_sq (sub_nonneg.mpr hle)⟩
target_source: ∀ p q : ℝ, 0 ≤ p → 0 ≤ q → q ≤ p ^ 2 → Real.sqrt (p + Real.sqrt q) = Real.sqrt ((p + Real.sqrt (p ^ 2 - q)) / 2) + Real.sqrt ((p - Real.sqrt (p ^ 2 - q)) / 2) ∧ Real.sqrt (p - Real.sqrt q) = Real.sqrt ((p + Real.sqrt (p ^ 2 - q)) / 2) - Real.sqrt ((p - Real.sqrt (p ^ 2 - q)) / 2)
